title: Semgrep not bundled
description: SecurityFullLayer invokes semgrep CLI for SAST. Not installable at build time due to env constraints.

title: Trivy not bundled
description: Container and filesystem vulnerability scanning via Trivy not available. Requires OS-level install.
resolution: brew install aquasecurity/trivy/trivy OR curl -sfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aquasecurity/trivy/main/contrib/install.sh | sh

title: Checkov not bundled
description: IaC scanning (Terraform, K8s manifests, Dockerfiles) via Checkov requires separate install.

title: CodeQL requires CI database build
description: CodeQL deep static analysis requires a two-phase flow: database creation during build, then query execution. Cannot run inline in ViabilityScan CLI.
resolution: Add github/codeql-action to CI workflow. See .github/workflows/viabilityscan.yml for commented example.

title: ScoutSuite requires cloud credentials
description: Cloud configuration analysis (AWS/GCP/Azure) requires live cloud credentials and cannot run in offline/static mode.
resolution: pip install scoutsuite && scout aws --report-dir ./scoutsuite-report (requires AWS credentials in environment)

title: Scoring weights require empirical calibration
description: Current weights (Security:0.4, Deployment:0.3, Reliability:0.3) and thresholds (V>=75, Sec>=70, Dep>=60, Rel>=60) are theoretically grounded but not empirically validated. Need calibration against known good/bad repos.
resolution: Collect 50+ repos with known production outcomes. Run ViabilityScan, record PASS/FAIL vs real-world outcome. Adjust weights in engine.py WEIGHTS and THRESHOLDS dicts using logistic regression.

title: Actual test coverage percentage unavailable
description: ReliabilityLayer estimates coverage via test file ratio. Actual line/branch coverage % requires running the test suite with coverage instrumentation. This requires executing potentially untrusted code.
resolution: Add sandboxed test runner option: docker run --rm -v <repo>:/app python:3.11 sh -c 'pip install -e . && pytest --cov --cov-report=json'. Parse coverage.json for actual %.

title: Cyclomatic complexity is heuristic-only
description: Current complexity analysis uses branch-keyword counting heuristic. Precise cyclomatic complexity requires AST parsing via radon (Python) or lizard (multi-language).
resolution: pip install radon lizard. Add: radon cc <repo> -j for JSON output. Parse and integrate into ReliabilityLayer.

title: Dependency vulnerability database is static subset
description: VULN_DEPS in security_mvp.py is a representative sample, not a live CVE database. Does not cover all packages or latest CVEs.
resolution: Integrate with OSV API (https://osv.dev/docs/) or Safety DB (pip install safety && safety check). For Node: integrate with npm audit --json.

title: NiceGUI dashboard requires nicegui package
description: dashboard/app.py implements a NiceGUI three-panel UI. Requires nicegui>=1.4 which is not bundled. Network access required.

title: Git history secret scanning not implemented
description: Current secret scanning only checks current file state. TruffleHog's primary value is scanning git commit history for secrets that were removed but remain in history.
resolution: Install trufflehog: brew install trufflesecurity/trufflehog/trufflehog. Run: trufflehog git file://<repo> --json. Parse and merge into SecurityMVPLayer findings.

title: SBOM generation not implemented
description: Software Bill of Materials generation (CycloneDX, SPDX) is recommended for supply chain security but not yet implemented.
resolution: pip install cyclonedx-bom && cyclonedx-py -o sbom.json. Or: syft <repo> -o cyclonedx-json > sbom.json

title: OSV vulnerability lookup disabled (no network)
description: Real-time CVE lookups against osv.dev API are disabled. ViabilityScan uses a static fallback vulnerability list instead.
resolution: When network available: implement osv_lookup() using requests.post('https://api.osv.dev/v1/querybatch', json={queries:[{package:{name:dep,ecosystem:'PyPI'}}]})

title: Python version detection not implemented
description: EOL Python versions (< 3.9 as of 2024) represent a security and support risk but are not detected.
resolution: Parse .python-version, pyproject.toml [tool.poetry.dependencies] python constraint, or runtime.txt. Flag versions < 3.9 as HIGH finding.

title: Node.js / Go / Java / Rust language layers not implemented
description: Current layers focus on Python. Dependency scanning, complexity, and ASVS checks for Node/Go/Java/Rust are not implemented.
resolution: Add language detection in engine._binary_scalar(). Route to language-specific sub-layers. For Node: parse package-lock.json and run npm audit --json. For Go: parse go.sum and run govulncheck.
